primary_and_official_sources.title: Combinatorial Testing
primary_and_official_sources.finding: Interaction failures are often caused by relatively few parameter interactions; t-way covering designs can compress large test spaces while preserving explicit interaction coverage.

primary_and_official_sources.title: Combinatorial Coverage Measurement
primary_and_official_sources.finding: Any test suite can be measured for t-way combinatorial coverage; scenario count alone is not a coverage measure.

primary_and_official_sources.title: Combinatorial Methods for Event Sequence Testing
primary_and_official_sources.finding: When ordering matters, sequence covering arrays can cover every t-event order with far fewer than all permutations; this is directly relevant to lifecycle/permission/session/network recovery ordering.

primary_and_official_sources.title: Lineage-driven Fault Injection
primary_and_official_sources.finding: LDFI reasons backward from a known-good outcome to choose only failures capable of invalidating its causal support, reducing redundant random injections and producing bounded counterexample reasoning.

primary_and_official_sources.title: AWS Fault Injection Service stop conditions and experiment templates
primary_and_official_sources.finding: Fault experiments should bind explicit targets/actions and stop conditions; stop conditions halt a run when predefined unacceptable thresholds are reached.

primary_and_official_sources.title: Start an experiment from a template
primary_and_official_sources.finding: AWS FIS snapshots the experiment template at start so later template edits do not alter the running experiment; this is a useful provenance rule for exact hostile-matrix execution identity.

primary_and_official_sources.title: The Chubby lock service for loosely-coupled distributed systems
primary_and_official_sources.finding: Sequencers bind lock generation to protected operations so recipients can reject delayed/stale authority; lock-delay is a weaker compatibility fallback. This directly supports WP1208 stale-authority non-revival tests.

primary_and_official_sources.title: Principles of Chaos Engineering
primary_and_official_sources.finding: Define measurable steady state, formulate a falsifiable hypothesis, inject realistic faults, compare control/experiment behavior, and minimize blast radius.

source_code_pin.role: historical executable LDFI research prototype reference only; not imported and not F2 evidence

observed_wp1208_strengths: deterministic case/matrix digesting binds scenario identity
every case must include all five declared fault families
cross-family concurrency is mandatory at one or more offsets
authority rebind policy already requires re-observation/rebind after generation change
protected cognition/canonical-state prefixes are rejected as direct chaos targets
source-level objects mechanically refuse runtime/physical/completion credit
research_gaps_against_sources: CASE_COUNT_NEQ_COVERAGE: MAX_CASES and unique case IDs bound quantity/identity but do not quantify t-way fault-parameter coverage.
CONCURRENCY_NEQ_SEQUENCE_COVERAGE: at least one cross-family concurrent offset does not test ordering-sensitive fault/recovery interactions.

ALL_FAMILIES_PER_CASE_MAY_OVERCONSTRAIN: forcing every case to contain all five families can waste budget on broad but causally irrelevant combinations and can make minimal counterexamples harder to isolate.
NO_CAUSAL_TARGETING: current planner composes supplied FaultSpec values but does not use outcome/evidence lineage to prioritize combinations capable of violating a declared invariant.
NO_EXPERIMENT_STOP_CONDITION_IN_PLAN: static bounds exist, but a later executable target-twin matrix needs explicit measured abort/stop conditions separate from case-size ceilings.

NO_TEMPLATE_SNAPSHOT_EXECUTION_BINDING_YET: source-level matrix digest is strong, but later runtime evidence must prove the executed run used an immutable snapshot of exact matrix/target-profile/source identities.

FENCE_PRESENT_NEQ_FENCE_ENFORCED: authority_fence_event_ids show generation changes, but later runtime acceptance must verify stale operations are actually rejected after the new generation becomes authoritative.
SCENARIO_COUNT_NEQ_INFORMATION_GAIN: there is no prioritization signal for previously uncovered t-way interactions, uncovered event orders, invariant-support lineage or prior negative evidence.
distilled_invariants: MEASURE_COVERAGE_NOT_VOLUME: report t-way interaction coverage and relevant event-order coverage, not only case/event counts.
USE_CONSTRAINED_COVERING_DESIGNS: generate compact scenario sets over fault factors subject to impossible/unsafe-combination constraints; do not Cartesian-product every family.
SEQUENCE_IS_A_SEPARATE_DIMENSION: explicitly cover recovery/failure order where authority/lifecycle semantics depend on order.

LINEAGE_PRIORITIZATION_IS_OPTIONAL_BUT_HIGH_VALUE: once an executable good outcome has typed evidence lineage, prioritize minimal fault cuts that could invalidate its mandatory support; never claim LDFI-style completeness without a sound bounded model.
IMMUTABLE_RUN_SNAPSHOT: execution receipt must bind the exact matrix digest, target-profile digest, source/tree identity, generation, stop-condition set and resolved scenario before intervention.
STOP_CONDITIONS_ARE_RUNTIME_GUARDS: distinguish static planning ceilings from dynamic measured abort thresholds; activation must be fail-closed and independently observable.
FENCING_REQUIRES_REJECTION_EVIDENCE: a generation change is not enough; the acceptance test must show stale sequencer/generation operations are rejected after recovery.
MINIMIZE_BLAST_RADIUS: start with the smallest target-twin scope and fault cut that can falsify the declared invariant; broaden only when coverage debt/information gain justifies it.
CONTROL_VS_EXPERIMENT: where feasible, match a no-fault/control run to the faulted run at exact source/target identity so degradation is attributable to the intervention rather than drift.
candidate_efficiency_metrics: cases executed per newly covered t-way interaction
events injected per newly covered event-order tuple
duplicate/redundant scenario ratio by normalized fault-cut identity
runtime cost per unique coverage increment
minimal counterexample fault-set size after reduction
abort/stop-condition activations with reason and exact threshold
stale-authority rejection count versus stale-authority attempts
control-versus-intervention delta under matched source/target identity
counterhypotheses: The existing five-family-per-case rule may already be cheap enough at F2 scale; adding t-way generation could complicate a deliberately bounded planner without discovering additional faults.
LDFI's benefits may not transfer because WP1208 currently lacks a sound causal-lineage model of target-twin outcomes; naïve pseudo-lineage would be worse than deterministic covering arrays.
Pairwise/t-way coverage can miss high-order faults; it is a search-efficiency heuristic and coverage metric, not proof of absence unless a stronger bounded model supplies that guarantee.
Dynamic stop conditions can themselves be stale or blind under the same fault being injected; the stop signal therefore needs an independent or explicitly degraded evidence path.

recommended_next_stage.objective: Map t-way/sequence coverage, optional causal-lineage prioritization, immutable run snapshot, dynamic stop-condition and stale-generation rejection evidence onto the exact WP1208 HostileChaosCase/HostileChaosMatrix fields and the later executable target-twin consumer without mutating accepted WP1208 source.
